reason: Retracted: AB 1078 (Firearms) runs both ways in one text. It tightens concealed-carry licensing but also raises the one-gun-a-month purchase limit to three and restores firearm rights for some out-of-state felonies. California batch-01 dropped it under filter 5 for that reason and batch-10 should not have overridden that; a gun_control stance label on it would mislead candidate sorting. See backend/evidence/rollcall/legiscan-ca-2172/batch-10/JUDGING.md.
